pool.text: James Cook charted Efate Island and gave it the name of Sandwich Island.
Franceville declared independence as a municipality which lasted until the following year.
An Anglo-French Condominium was formally established to jointly administer the territory.
The Union of Moderate Parties won the majority of votes in the city.
Cyclone Uma struck the city and caused severe damage across the area.
The National United Party emerged as a third political party in Port Vila.
Vanua'aku regained the plurality of votes and won a majority of seats.
The destination welcomed over eighty thousand visitors during the course of the year.
UNESCO hosted the second World Heritage Global Strategy Meeting for the Pacific Islands Region.
Tafea FC reached the final of the OFC Men's Champions League tournament.
A powerful earthquake struck the capital and surrounding areas, causing minor damage.
An archaeological expedition discovered twenty-five tombs containing Lapita culture skeletons.
The Union of Moderate Parties won no seats after recording a very low vote share.
Amicale FC reached the final of the OFC Men's Champions League competition.
Amicale FC reached the final match of the OFC Men's Champions League.
Cyclone Pam passed near the city, causing massive damage as a category five storm.
Tafea FC claimed its first league championship title in a decade.
The Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-Day Saints announced plans to build a city temple.
Municipal council elections were held for the local government administration.
The VFF Women's Champions League began operation as the women's tournament equivalent.
